name: 30° Dive CCIP
summary: Roll in from 8,000 ft, 30° dive, pickle at 4,500 ft
procedure: A/G master mode, CCIP on the stores page, correct station and program
Roll in, pipper short of the target and let it walk up
Pickle at release altitude — 4 G recovery

name: 45° Dive CCIP
summary: Steep dive from 10,000 ft, pickle at 6,000 ft
procedure: A/G master mode, CCIP
Steep roll-in — watch speed, throttle back
Pickle at release altitude — 4.5 G recovery, do not press

name: Pop-up 4 nm
summary: Low run-in, pop at 4 nm to a 7,000 ft apex, 20° dive
procedure: A/G master mode, CCIP set before the IP
At the pop: pull, full power, check the apex altitude
Roll in, pipper on, pickle at release altitude

name: Level AUTO 15k (LGB)
summary: Straight and level, TPOD lase, AUTO release
procedure: A/G master mode, AUTO; TPOD designate the target, laser code set
Wings level, pickle and hold — release at the cue
Lase from 8–10 s before impact until impact

name: Level AUTO 18k (JDAM)
summary: Straight and level inside the LAR, AUTO release
procedure: A/G master mode, JDAM page: target coordinates loaded
Inside the LAR: wings level, pickle and hold until release

name: Laydown 500 ft (HD)
summary: Fast and low, AUTO release of high-drag bombs
procedure: High-drag / retarded bombs only
A/G master mode, AUTO, target designated
Level at 500 ft, pickle and hold through release

name: Maverick 8k level
summary: Medium altitude, lock and fire inside range
procedure: A/G master mode, Maverick selected and uncaged
Slew to the target, lock, confirm in range
Fire — keep the nose on until launch
